request: The items page lists every item, which becomes unwieldy as the list grows. Add a filter input above the list that narrows the visible items to those whose name contains what you type, case-insensitively, without another API call. Cover the filtering in the UI test, and make sure the app still builds and the pages still render.

plan.goal: Let a user narrow the displayed items by name without refetching them from the API.

scope.title: A client-side name filter on the items page
scope.description: Add a labelled filter input to src/pages/Items.tsx whose value narrows the rendered list to items whose name contains the query case-insensitively, using the already-fetched items. Extend the items-page test in test/app.test.tsx to cover narrowing and restoring the list.

steps.description: Add a labelled text input to src/pages/Items.tsx above the item list, with its own piece of local state.
Render only the items whose name contains the query, compared case-insensitively, leaving the fetched list untouched.
Extend the items-page test in test/app.test.tsx to type a query that matches some of the stubbed items and assert the others are hidden, then run the build and both test suites.

out_of_scope.item: Filtering on the server through a query parameter
out_of_scope.reason: The request is to narrow the items already displayed; a server-side query is a larger change the list does not need yet.

out_of_scope.item: Sorting the list as well as filtering it
out_of_scope.reason: Sorting is a separate behaviour and the API already returns items in id order.
